title: Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts hybrid decoder (qwen3_5_moe_text) from a GGUF, over the device plugins
description: Qwen3.5 MoE's text decoder (transformers' modeling_qwen3_5_moe, llama.cpp's qwen35moe graph): three Gated DeltaNet layers (16 key and 32 value heads of 128, a causal conv of 4, the gated delta rule through the recurrence slot, a gated RMS norm) for every gated full-attention layer (16 query and 2 KV heads of 256, query and key norms, RoPE theta 1e7 over the first 64 dims, the output times sigmoid of a per-head gate), each followed by 256 routed SwiGLU experts (softmax router, top 8, renormalized) beside a shared SwiGLU expert scaled by a sigmoid gate; untied head. Weights read from the GGUF as stored (gguf-projections, gguf-experts; FP32 matrices in FP32); the token embedding in host memory; routed experts in device slots by a residency profile, the rest in pinned host memory read over the link; KV in qwen35-attention's paged pools, recurrent state in qwen35-recurrence's slots; every step of many sequences one batch, each prompt chunk alone and decode rows 8 at a time, decode steps captured in CUDA graphs per row count. The model type (qwen3_5_moe_text) is checked when the plugin is made: crit 0.17.1 derives no model_type fact for a run whose model is a lone GGUF file, so the manifest names no needs.

context.description: positions served when the loader names no context

reserve_mib.description: device MiB left free after the routed experts' slots (the run's headroom, a prompt step's temporaries, graph pools)

expert_mib.description: at most this many MiB of routed experts in device slots (0: whatever the reserve leaves)

profile.description: a residency profile (JSON, per-layer route counts) beside the plugin: the most routed experts take the device slots

decode_graphs.description: capture the decode step per row count in CUDA graphs at load

adapt_every.description: decode steps between expert residency adaptations (0: never)

lend_floor_tokens.description: KV positions never lent to host experts (the pool's pages above them hold lent expert copies until a sequence needs them)

step_budget_ms.description: a prompt row computes at most the tokens its step's cost model keeps under this many ms (crit serve settles a cancel only between steps, within 1 s); 0: the whole grant

step_base_ms.description: the cost model's fixed part of a prompt step (staging touched host experts, the dense layers' launch)

step_token_us.description: the cost model's microseconds a prompt token

step_key_ps.description: the cost model's picoseconds a prompt token per position it attends to (all full-attention layers)
